# Gabochie

> Independent comparisons of SEO and marketing tools for solo founders, freelancers, and small agencies.

## Overview

- Name: Gabochie
- Focus: SEO tool reviews, comparisons, and buying guides
- Audience: Solo founders, freelancers, and small businesses doing their own SEO
- Language: English
- Contact: gabochie@gmail.com

## Core pages

- [Best SEO tool for small businesses and solo founders](https://x.gabochie.com/): Semrush is the best all-in-one SEO tool for small businesses and solo founders in 2026. Compares Semrush vs Ahrefs vs Moz Pro vs Ubersuggest with pricing and recommendation.
- [Semrush vs Ahrefs in 2026](https://x.gabochie.com/ahrefs-vs-semrush.html): Semrush wins for complete SEO workflows; Ahrefs wins for backlink analysis and link building. Side-by-side comparison of price, features, and who each tool fits.
- [Best budget SEO tools in 2026](https://x.gabochie.com/best-budget-seo-tools.html): Free stack (Google Search Console, Analytics, Ahrefs Webmaster Tools) plus cheap upgrades (Ubersuggest ~$12/mo) and the best all-in-one value (Semrush Pro $129.95/mo).
- [Best AI SEO tools in 2026](https://x.gabochie.com/best-ai-seo-tools.html): Semrush is the best all-in-one AI SEO tool; Surfer SEO for specialized content scoring; free options for starting out.
- [Privacy Policy](https://x.gabochie.com/privacy.html): how the site handles data, cookies, and affiliate links.

## Key facts

- Semrush Pro starts at $129.95/month (annual billing lowers the effective monthly cost).
- Semrush wins for small businesses/agencies: complete workflow (keywords, competitors, site audit, rank tracking, local SEO, AI content tools) at a lower entry price than Ahrefs.
- Ahrefs has the stronger backlink index; choose it when link analysis is the main task.
- Best free SEO tools: Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Ahrefs Webmaster Tools.
- AI-generated content is not automatically penalized, but Google rewards helpful, original content.
